SELECT /* LGVPAY00014.retrieveFormulaList */ pcf.payroll_calculation_formula_id /* 급여산출산식아이디 */ , pcf.payroll_calc_formula_value /* 급여산출산식문자값 */ ,(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi WHERE ppi.payroll_calculation_formula_id = pcf.payroll_calculation_formula_id AND ppi.subsidiary_code= #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ) AS delete_enable_flag /* 1이상인 경우 삭제 불가 */ FROM tb_pay_calc_formula_n pcf WHERE 1=1
AND pcf.payroll_calculation_formula_id = #{srchPayrollCalculationFormulaId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여산출산식아이디 */
AND pcf.payroll_calc_formula_value LIKE '%'||#{payrollCalcFormulaValue}||'%'
ORDER BY pcf.payroll_calc_formula_value

WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAY00014.retireveValidateFormulaData */ payroll_calculation_formula_id , payroll_calc_formula_value FROM tb_pay_calc_formula_n /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ WHERE payroll_calculation_formula_id NOT IN #{deleted[${idx}].payrollCalculationFormulaId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) , rs AS ( SELECT -1 AS payroll_calculation_formula_id , #{created[${idx}].payrollCalcFormulaValue} AS payroll_calc_formula_value FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT detail_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id , NVL(update_list.payroll_calc_formula_value, detail_list.payroll_calc_formula_value) AS payroll_calc_formula_value FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Detail 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Detail 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT #{updated[${idx}].payrollCalculationFormulaId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS payroll_calculation_formula_id , #{updated[${idx}].payrollCalcFormulaValue} AS payroll_calc_formula_value FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id = update_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id(+) SELECT detail_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id , detail_list.payroll_calc_formula_value FROM detail_list ) SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT listagg(rs.payroll_calc_formula_value, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.payroll_calc_formula_value) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) AS dup_names FROM rs GROUP BY rs.payroll_calc_formula_value HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AS dup_names /* 중복된 Formula 항목명 */ ,(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM rs WHERE rs.payroll_calc_formula_value IS NULL) AS name_empty_flag /* Formula명 없는 경우 */ ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.formulaProgram' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_names_title FROM dual
mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAY00014.insertFormula */ INTO tb_pay_calc_formula_n( payroll_calculation_formula_id /* 급여산출산식아이디 */ , payroll_calc_formula_value /* 급여산출산식문자값 */ , creation_date /* 생성일자 */ , creation_user_id /* 생성사용자아이디 */ ) VALUES ( sq_tb_pay_calc_formula_n.nextval /* payroll_calculation_formula_id => 급여산출산식아이디 */ , #{payrollCalcFormulaValue} /* payroll_calc_formula_value => 급여산출산식문자값 */ , SYSDATE /* creation_date => 생성일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* creation_user_id => 생성사용자아이디 */ )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAY00014.updateFormula */ tb_pay_calc_formula_n SET payroll_calc_formula_value = #{payrollCalcFormulaValue} /* 급여산출산식문자값 */ WHERE payroll_calculation_formula_id = #{payrollCalculationFormulaId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여산출산식아이디 */

mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAY00014.retrieveFormulaDetailList */ a.payroll_calculation_formula_id , a.sort_order_no , a.sort_order_no AS ori_sort_order_no , a.parameter_io_type_code , cccm1.common_code_name AS parameter_io_type_name , a.parameter_value , a.data_type_code , cccm.common_code_name AS data_type_name , pid.payroll_item_id , ppi.inquiry_name AS payroll_item_name , a.payroll_item_detail_detail_id , pid.additional_input_value AS payroll_item_detail_name , pid.pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code FROM tb_pay_calc_formula_param_n a , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm1 , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi WHERE a.payroll_calculation_formula_id = #{payrollCalculationFormulaId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND cccm.code_type_code = 'LGDVHR_PAY_DATA_TYPE_CODE' AND cccm.common_code = a.data_type_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND cccm1.code_type_code = 'LGDVHR_PAY_PARAMETER_TYPE_CODE' AND cccm1.common_code = a.parameter_io_type_code AND cccm1.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id(+) = a.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND ppi.payroll_item_id(+) = pid.payroll_item_id ORDER BY a.sort_order_no

WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAY00014.retireveValidateFormulaDetailData */ payroll_calculation_formula_id , sort_order_no , parameter_value FROM tb_pay_calc_formula_param_n WHERE payroll_calculation_formula_id = #{parameter.payrollCalculationFormulaId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ AND sort_order_no NOT IN #{deleted[${idx}].sortOrderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) , rs AS ( SELECT -1 AS payroll_calculation_formula_id , #{created[${idx}].sortOrderNo} AS sort_order_no , #{created[${idx}].parameterValue} AS parameter_value FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT detail_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id , NVL(update_list.sort_order_no, detail_list.sort_order_no) AS sort_order_no , NVL(update_list.parameter_value, detail_list.parameter_value) AS parameter_value FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Detail 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Detail 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT #{parameter.payrollCalculationFormulaId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS payroll_calculation_formula_id , #{updated[${idx}].sortOrderNo} AS sort_order_no , #{updated[${idx}].parameterValue} AS parameter_value , #{updated[${idx}].oriSortOrderNo} AS ori_sort_order_no FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id = update_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id(+) AND detail_list.sort_order_no = update_list.ori_sort_order_no(+) SELECT detail_list.payroll_calculation_formula_id , detail_list.sort_order_no , detail_list.parameter_value FROM detail_list ) SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT listagg(rs.sort_order_no, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.sort_order_no) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) AS dup_sort_order FROM rs GROUP BY rs.sort_order_no HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AS dup_sort_orders /* 중복된 정렬순서번호 */ ,(SELECT DISTINCT listagg(rs.parameter_value, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.parameter_value) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) AS dup_names FROM rs GROUP BY rs.parameter_value HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AS dup_names /* 중복된 Parameter명 */ ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'SortOrder' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_sort_orders_title ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'ParameterName' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_names_title FROM dual
